import matplotlib

    test_fig, test_ax = plt.subplots()

plt.rcParams['xtick.major.size'] = 3

C_GREEN = '#27AE60'

cross_str = r'$\times$' if USE_LATEX else '✗'

fig = plt.figure(figsize=(14, 4.2), dpi=300)
